name: Ulam
overview: The name Ulam appears in Scripture as a descendant in two distinct genealogies, highlighting the importance of lineage in God's providential plan. In 1 Chronicles 7:16-17, Ulam is identified as a son of Sheresh within the tribe of Manasseh, emphasizing his place in a God-ordained family line. Separately, 1 Chronicles 8:39-40 presents Ulam as the firstborn son of Eshek from the tribe of Benjamin, noted for his valor and skill as an archer, reflecting the strength and faithfulness God grants His people. These passages collectively underscore God's sovereign hand in preserving His people through faithful generations, marked by both heritage and character.
